records.summary: OpenAI launched a new science blog with a guest post from UCSB physicist Nathaniel Craig, who describes how GPT-6 Astra helped turn his strategy into a candidate lattice definition of the Standard Model, a problem open for decades, while noting key gaps remain before it is a practical tool.
records.title: A step toward defining the Standard Model on a lattice

records.summary: A firm owned by Alice Huang, the former lover of ousted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, arranged nearly $12 billion in Nvidia chip orders for Chinese companies between 2024 and 2025, according to documents reviewed by the Wall Street Journal, suggesting far more of Nvidia's revenue came from China than officially reported.
records.title: Firm linked to Jensen Huang's ex-lover reportedly brokered nearly $12 billion in Nvidia chip orders for China

records.summary: A Reserve Bank of Australia analysis finds AI exposure is hitting young entry-level workers first: job postings and employment for 15- to 24-year-olds in highly exposed fields like software and customer service have fallen more sharply than for older workers since ChatGPT launched.
records.title: Australia's central bank finds AI hitting young workers first, especially in software and customer service

records.summary: Former Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon says a slide from Anthropic's IPO roadshow shows algorithmic efficiency improving at an accelerating rate, claiming its Mythos model could already be retrained with a fraction of its original compute, and he calls for a pause on frontier model development.
records.title: Anthropic can already retrain Mythos with "a fraction of the compute originally needed," says former researcher Coxon

records.summary: An OpenAI board member warns that AI systems could take over key parts of society within months, voicing concern about how quickly frontier models are concentrating power and control.
records.title: OpenAI board member worries an AI "takeover" of society could be months away

records.summary: Google Research is opening Antigravity's /teamwork multi-agent tools to outside researchers, reporting human-supervised Gemini 4 workflows that proved open math conjectures, produced million-line machine-checked Lean formalizations, and rewrote production code.
records.title: Advancing science & engineering with Antigravity's /teamwork

records.summary: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon is now generally available after a two-week testing phase, topping the MathArena benchmark and leading coding and automation benchmarks, while also finding real zero-day vulnerabilities in security testing.
records.title: Gemini 4 Carbon arrives just in time to feel like yesterday's news in the fastest model cycle yet

records.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Meetings, which joins Google Meet calls as a visible participant and drafts plans, timelines and action items in real time, alongside Claude Whiteboards and Claude Sheets for paid plans.
records.title: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings to turn workplace discussions into plans and tasks

records.summary: Anthropic launched the roadshow for its proposed IPO, offering 825 million Class A shares at an expected $70 to $78 each and seeking a Nasdaq listing under the ticker ANT.
records.title: Anthropic launches roadshow for proposed initial public offering

records.summary: Apple partnered with OpenEvidence on a new study app that invites up to 200,000 US participants to ask health questions and get answers grounded in clinical literature, to learn how people use and evaluate health AI.
records.title: Apple launches new app to study how people use AI for health

records.summary: Members of Congress are pushing to tighten export controls on AI chips, aiming to close loopholes that have let advanced hardware reach China despite existing restrictions.
records.title: Congress wants to tighten export rules for AI chips

records.summary: Meituan released the open weights for LongCat-2.5, a 1.6-trillion-parameter model built for autonomous coding agents, under the MIT license; it was trained entirely on Chinese hardware, with a sample deployment running on 194 Huawei Ascend chips.
records.title: Meituan releases a 1.6-trillion-parameter agent model that never touched an Nvidia GPU

records.summary: OpenAI dissolved its standalone robotics team for the second time, folding researchers into its main research and applied groups on the view that general-purpose models like GPT-6 Astra can control robots directly.
records.title: OpenAI reassigns robotics researchers to other teams as general-purpose models might make specialized robotics AI unnecessary

records.summary: ElevenLabs launched ElevenAI, a preview app that combines meeting note-taking, dictation, and agent integrations for teams, positioning its voice AI as a workplace knowledge hub.
records.title: ElevenLabs' new app combines meeting note-taking and dictation for teams

records.summary: Cohere completed its acquisition of vulnerability-discovery firm AISLE and welcomed the team behind AI code-review platform cubic, forming a new cybersecurity business, Cohere Cyber, and a secure coding vertical.
records.title: Cohere Expands Its Sovereign AI Platform with AISLE and cubic

records.summary: DeepMind openly released PARDIG and SatWeave, the satellite and precipitation datasets behind its WeatherNext 3 forecasting model, with historical archives and live feeds available on Google Cloud Storage and Earth Engine.
records.title: Opening the datasets behind our AI weather models

records.summary: The FAA expanded its use of AI-based advice for managing air traffic congestion to the entire US airspace, extending a system that helps controllers route flights around delays.
records.title: FAA expands AI advice to manage air traffic congestion across entire US airspace

records.summary: United Airlines said it will restrict AI agents from booking flights and managing reservations on customers' behalf, warning that sharing account credentials with third-party AI assistants risks unintended purchases and security breaches.
records.title: United Airlines blocks AI agents from booking flights, citing cybersecurity risks

records.summary: Meta's AI assistant Muse can now place phone calls to US businesses on users' behalf, rolling out to paid subscribers after a limited test in September.
records.title: Muse can now place calls to US businesses — if you pay

records.summary: Runway released Praxis-1, its 27-billion-parameter world action model for robot control, with open weights under the Apache 2.0 license, including inference and fine-tuning code for commercial use.
records.title: Praxis-1 Is Now Available

records.summary: DeepMind launched AlphaGenome 2, a model that predicts how DNA variants affect gene activity in specific human cell types, trained on more than 100 million single-cell profiles and available to researchers via an API.
records.title: AlphaGenome 2: Deciphering how cells read DNA to better understand disease

records.summary: TSMC plans to invest $1 billion in OpenAI, deepening the ties between the world's largest chipmaker and the AI lab as both race to secure compute capacity.
records.title: Taiwan's chipmaking giant TSMC to invest $1B in OpenAI

records.summary: Microsoft researchers showed that reprogramming fewer than ten dormant neurons in a model can plant a hidden backdoor that makes an AI agent run an attacker's command when a trigger appears, while the model otherwise passes standard evaluations. Microsoft says it has not seen the technique used by threat actors.
records.title: Lazare, veni foras: Reprogramming Dormant Neurons to Backdoor AI Agents

records.summary: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, its most capable models for demanding technical work, with up to 30% faster token generation, lower prices, and strong results in coding, science, and robotics benchmarks.
records.title: Introducing Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2

records.summary: Alibaba's Qwen team introduced Qwen4-Max, a new flagship built on the Qwen4 architecture with a 2.4-trillion-parameter backbone (71B active per token), native vision and a one-million-token context window. Qwen says it cuts cost per task by about 62% versus Qwen3.8-Max on its Work360 benchmark and lowers API prices, positioning the model as a 24/7 AI teammate for professional work.
records.title: Alibaba unveils Qwen4-Max, a 2.4T-parameter model built as an AI teammate

records.summary: EU heads of state and government held their first in-depth discussion devoted to AI at an informal summit in Dublin, hearing from Mistral CEO Arthur Mensch and Geoffrey Hinton. Leaders focused on competitiveness and AI sovereignty; the Commission floated around €30 billion in gigafactory compute and said at least €500 billion is needed overall.
records.title: EU leaders hold first dedicated AI summit in Dublin

records.summary: llama.cpp and its ggml tensor library reached v1.0.0 on November 13, adopting semantic versioning so breaking changes to the public C API will arrive only as major-version bumps. The release removes 35 deprecated functions and adds FP8 KV caches and a host-memory cache for MoE models.
records.title: llama.cpp and ggml reach v1.0 with a stable API promise

records.summary: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia's CEO, president and board member after reports of extramarital affairs, including one with a woman US officials suspect of spying for China. CFO Colette Kress takes over as interim CEO while the board searches for a successor; Nvidia shares fell sharply on the news.
records.title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia chief executive

records.summary: DeepMind unveiled Gemini Robotics 2.5, its most capable vision-language-action model, reporting 30–100% higher task success than its predecessor. In a factory pilot, Apptronik Apollo 2 humanoids running the model sorted metal parts on live Mercedes-Benz production lines at a reported 96% success rate.
records.title: Gemini Robotics 2.5 hits 96% sorting parts on Mercedes-Benz factory lines

records.summary: DeepMind's AlphaProof Code, a multi-agent framework powered by Gemini 4 Carbon, formally verified key security properties of Signal's libsignal code down to machine instructions — about 6.5 million lines of Lean proof produced in four weeks. DeepMind calls it the first formal verification of a widely deployed cryptographic protocol at this depth, and open-sourced the artifacts.
records.title: DeepMind's AlphaProof Code formally verifies Signal's cryptography

records.summary: Fireworks AI said a second intrusion path through a third-party cloud provider let attackers reach customer billing data and, for a limited set of accounts, secrets, datasets and incomplete model weights. The November 9 update expands an October incident the inference platform first disclosed on October 9.
records.title: Fireworks AI breach widened: billing data, datasets and partial model weights accessed

records.summary: Meta released Muse Ember, its smallest and cheapest model, built for the repetitive work inside agents: tool calls, routing, extraction and coding subtasks. At $0.10/$0.50 per million tokens, Artificial Analysis says it matches Claude Haiku 5.5's intelligence score at about a third of the cost per task.
records.title: Meta releases Muse Ember, its smallest and cheapest model

records.summary: OpenAI announced GPT-6 Cyber, a cybersecurity-specialized variant of GPT-6 Astra for vulnerability discovery, exploit development and penetration testing. Rated Critical under OpenAI's Preparedness Framework, it is limited to vetted Daybreak Red customers; OpenAI says it found 81 previously unknown high-severity Firefox flaws and scored 48.5% on ExploitGym.
records.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Cyber, a Critical-rated model for vetted security teams

records.summary: Baidu open-sourced ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base, a 280B-parameter mixture-of-experts model with 14B active per token, publishing FP8 and BF16 weights on Hugging Face and ModelScope. It is a raw pre-training checkpoint for others to fine-tune, and its custom license excludes the EU, UK and South Korea.
records.title: Baidu open-sources ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base, a 280B MoE model

records.summary: Google will backstop Anthropic's rent obligations under TeraWulf's 20-year leases for about 401 MW at its Justified campus in Kentucky, covering roughly $19 billion of contracted commitments. TeraWulf disclosed the credit support agreements in an 8-K filed November 4, alongside a Fluor construction deal.
records.title: Google backstops Anthropic's $19B TeraWulf data-center lease

records.summary: Meta acquired Conductor, the Mac app that runs several AI coding agents in parallel workspaces, for an undisclosed sum; the ten-person team joins Meta Superintelligence Labs. Conductor Cloud goes read-only November 13 and shuts down November 20, when cloud data deletion begins.
records.title: Meta acquires Conductor, the parallel coding-agents app

records.summary: OpenAI announced Images 2.6 across ChatGPT, Codex and the API, adding native animated GIF generation, SVG output, markup-guided editing and a complexity control. The API gets two models — GPT-Image-2.6 Flare for speed and Sunburst for detail — at the same token prices as 2.5.
records.title: OpenAI ships GPT Image 2.6 with GIF and SVG output

records.summary: Mistral published the weights of Large 4, its 1.05-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts flagship, on Hugging Face under a modified MIT license after three extra weeks of reinforcement learning. It is the strongest open-weight model built outside China, though running it still takes an 8-GPU datacenter node.
records.title: Mistral releases Large 4 weights: a trillion-parameter open model

records.summary: Google announced Gemini 4 Carbon, its strongest model yet, built on Gemini 4 Argon with state-of-the-art cybersecurity and long-horizon capabilities. It ranks first on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0 and rolls out first to cyber defenders through the Fairwind Program at $2/$10 per million tokens.
records.title: Introducing Gemini 4 Carbon

records.summary: DeepMind announced Genie 4, a world model that generates interactive environments you can walk through and steer with text in real time — now with native sound and dialogue. It holds a scene together for up to two minutes, double Genie 3, and is out as a research preview for trusted testers.
records.title: DeepMind's Genie 4 generates real-time worlds with sound

records.summary: Anthropic publicly filed its preliminary S-1 on October 26, proposing a Nasdaq listing under the ticker ANT. The filing discloses $16.3B in first-half 2026 revenue alongside a large GAAP net loss driven by fair-value changes; the price range and share count are not yet set.
records.title: Anthropic files public S-1 for Nasdaq IPO under ticker ANT

records.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Terra on October 26, a fast mid-tier model for visual reasoning, computer use and writing, priced at $1 per million input tokens and $5 output — half the cost of GPT-5.6 Terra. It is live in ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API with a 1.05M-token context window.
records.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Terra, a cheaper model for computer use

records.summary: Claude Fable 5.2, released Nov 9, completed 41.25% of real freelance projects on the Remote Labor Index; Anthropic also launched Claude Sheets, Whiteboards and Data on Nov 10.
records.title: Here's how Anthropic's latest products could automate your job

records.summary: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet with American Express, Mastercard and Visa: its dots agents can complete purchases with tokenized cards, with a biometric security check for every purchase. Rolling out to US ChatGPT Pro subscribers.
records.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet for secure AI agent payments

records.summary: A WSJ investigation, reported by TechPowerUp, alleges Nvidia engineered GPU scarcity by arranging credit support for AI startups and small cloud providers that bought its chips — financing its own demand while customers faced shortages. The story topped Hacker News with 1,005 points.
records.title: Nvidia allegedly funded startups to buy its own GPUs

records.summary: Agent management startup LangChain raised a $300M Series C at a $3B valuation led by CapitalG, more than double its $1.25B valuation from a year ago, with GIC, DFJ Growth, IVP and Sapphire Ventures participating.
records.title: AI agent startup LangChain hits $3B valuation

records.summary: Google released Gemini 4 Hydrogen, its fast, cheap tier for coding and agentic workflows: $1.50/$7.50 per million tokens, a free API tier, and a 51 score on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index — one point above the flagship Argon.
records.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a cheaper model that edges past its flagship Argon

records.summary: Claude Fable 5.2 topped the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at 65; Meta released Muse Ember at $0.10 per million input tokens, OpenAI limited GPT-6 Cyber to approved security customers, and Gemini Robotics 2.5 hit 96% success sorting parts on Mercedes-Benz lines.
records.title: Anthropic's Claude tops AI rankings as OpenAI limits cyber model
